items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: He says, "Got an idea. How would you like to work with Dollar Brand?"

ctx.x: 'You know, I can't go to do any gigs.' He said, 'No, you can't do that, but you got a hit record in South Africa.' So he had told Hank that he would like to do some -- he thought it would be nice if we could do something together because he's

from South Africa and, you know, by me having a little name in South Africa, together with the both names, he thought it would sell good and I think it did, you know. So I was playing up to the Crawdaddy and Hank, he came up to see me. He says, "Got an idea. How would you like to work with Dollar Brand?" I says, "Who?" He says, "With Dollar Brand." I says -- he brought him with him. So he says, "He would like to make an album with you." So I says, "Yeah, it's all right with me, but you know, it's two different…
